items.title: An opportunity to contribute your thoughts on plastic waste management
items.summary:
As part of our collaboration with the Maritime Association for Clean Seas (MACS), we are pleased to share information about an upcoming virtual round table on plastic waste management.
BIMCO members are therefore invited to attend and contribute practical operational experience.

items.title: BIMCO Energy Saving Device Retrofit Addendum available to support vessel efficiency investments
items.summary:
The addendum provides owners and charterers with a flexible mechanism for agreeing how the costs, time, fuel-saving benefits and environmental benefits associated with retrofit projects should be allocated between them.

items.title: We have updated RECYCLECON – the global standard contract for sustainable ship recycling
items.summary:
The update reflects the entry into force of the Hong Kong Convention last year, as well as significant developments in ship recycling practice, regulatory requirements and sale and purchase procedures. 
It replaces the 2012 edition and is now known as RECYCLECON 2026. It is BIMCO’s standard agreemen

items.title: eBL adoption passes halfway mark
items.summary:
Electronic bill of lading (eBL) adoption has reached 51.1%, according to the FIT Alliance’s 2026 global survey, up from 49.2% in 2024 and 33% in 2022.
BIMCO is a founding member of the alliance.

items.title: BIMCO expands with new consultant in Japan
items.summary:
We are pleased to welcome Makoto Iwasaki as our representative in Japan, further strengthening support for our members, SmartCon customers and SHIP PI users across one of the world's most important maritime markets.

items.title: Dry bulk safety: scrap metal fires, fumigation and enclosed spaces
items.summary:
BIMCO’s Dry Bulk Cargo Network discussed three persistent safety challenges at its latest meeting: fire risks from contaminated scrap metal cargoes, the shift of fumigation duties from specialists to ships’ crews, and continuing fatalities in enclosed spaces.
Members highlighted the need for clearer
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 乾散貨網路在最新會議中討論了三項持續的安全挑戰：受污染的廢金屬貨物引發的火災風險。熏蒸工作正從專業人員轉移至船舶船員執行。密閉空間內的死亡事故仍持續發生。成員強調需要更明確的指引與程序以減少這些風險。

items.title: New BIMCO contracts tackle ship recycling and energy-saving retrofits
items.summary: We have adopted two new contractual solutions designed to help you manage important operational and regulatory challenges: the revised RECYCLECON contract and the Energy Saving Device Retrofit Addendum 2026.
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 推出經修訂的 RECYCLECON 合約，協助應對船舶回收相關的營運與規範挑戰。同時發布 2026 年節能裝置改裝附加條款，提供節能改裝的合約框架。

items.title: Where are the whales? Useful tools you can use to help protect them
items.summary:
As whales migrate into critical habitats, many authorities are activating seasonal and dynamic measures that can affect how should ships transit certain areas.
We recommend you check if any of your ships are travelling through areas with mandatory and voluntary whale strike reduction measures and if
items.summary_zh: 鯨魚進入關鍵棲息地時，各主管機關會啟動季節性與動態性措施，影響船舶在特定海域的航行。建議檢查貴船隊是否有航經設有強制或自願性鯨魚撞擊減少措施的區域。

items.title: Supporting seafarers
items.summary:
“Threats to freedom of navigation affect both global trade and the people who keep it moving.”
That was the clear message from BIMCO Secretary General & CEO, David Loosley to Sagarmanthan: The Great Oceans Dialogue in New Delhi this week.
items.summary_zh:
威脅航行自由將影響全球貿易與維持貿易運行的海員。
此為BIMCO秘書長兼執行長David Loosley在新德里舉辦的Sagarmanthan：Great Oceans Dialogue中發表的明確訊息。

items.title: New addendum helps unlock investment in energy-saving retrofits
items.summary:
A new BIMCO addendum gives owners and charterers a practical way to agree how they will share the costs and benefits of installing energy-saving technology during a time charter.
The BIMCO Energy Saving Device Retrofit Addendum 2026 is designed to help overcome this challenge.
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 發布 2026 年節能裝置改裝附加條款，為船東與租船人提供在定期租船期間共擔節能技術安裝成本與效益的機制。該附加條款旨在解決雙方在能源節約改裝上成本分擔的難題。

items.title: Shipping can tap into a wider seafaring talent pool by including more women, BIMCO panel hears
items.summary: With women making up only 1.2% of seafarers, shipping has a major opportunity to broaden its talent pool, BIMCO’s Ship Manager Advisory Panel heard at its latest meeting.  Meeting on 25 September 2026, the panel discussed the recruitment of women seafarers alongside another pressing workforce issue:
items.summary_zh: 女性僅佔船員的1.2%。顯示航運業擁有擴大人才庫的重大機遇。BIMCO船舶管理諮詢小組於2026年9月25日會議中討論了女性船員的招募，並將其與另一項緊迫的勞動力議題併討論。

items.title: Strait of Hormuz security, decarbonisation among key issues discussed by BIMCO committees
items.summary:
The security situation in the Strait of Hormuz and the Black and Red Seas, as well as environmental topics, were among the key issues discussed when BIMCO’s Maritime Safety & Security Committee (MSSC) and Marine Environment Committee (MEC) met on 30 September and 1 October.
Members considered the im
items.summary_zh: BIMCO 的 Maritime Safety & Security Committee 與 Marine Environment Committee 於 9 月 30 日及 10 月 1 日舉行會議。會議主要討論了霍爾muz 海峽、黑海與紅海的安全情況。環境議題亦為會議重點。

items.title: An urgent appeal to help shape the future IMO Biofouling Convention
items.summary:
IMO member states are negotiating what will become the first legally binding global Convention on biofouling management. The decisions being made now could affect how ships are operated, inspected, cleaned and maintained for years to come.
The industry therefore needs to make its voice heard, and we
items.summary_zh: IMO 成員國正在談判將成為首個具有法律約束力的全球性生物污防管理公約。目前的決策將可能影響船舶未來多年的操作、檢驗、清潔與維護方式。因此，業界必須發表意見，以參與塑造該公約的最終內容。

items.title: Remember the special BIMCO clauses for US and China port fees
items.summary:
Recent reports indicate that the reciprocal port fee measures introduced by the United States and China may remain suspended until 10 January 2027. If confirmed, this would remove the immediate prospect of the fees being reintroduced in November 2026.
However, uncertainty remains both as to the long
items.summary_zh: 美國與中國的互惠港口費用措施可能維持暫停至2027年1月10日。若此情況得到確認，則原定於2026年11月重新實施的費用將不會出現。然而，長期情況仍存在不確定性。

items.title: Are skill gaps in your team costing you time and money?
items.summary:
Standard training courses do not always address the specific challenges your staff encounter in their day-to-day work.
BIMCO’s customised inhouse training takes a different approach.

items.summary_zh: 標準培訓課程未必能針對員工日常工作遇到的具體挑戰。BIMCO 提供客製化內部培訓，採取不同的方式。您可以與 BIMCO 合作，決定培訓目標與內容。
